lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Hey, Cutey!

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Got a minute?
I'm not doing it...
Sure.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: You don't even know what I was going to say.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: What, were you afraid I'd make you be my test subject? Hehe.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Perfect.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: It's not about an experiment this time.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Everyone says it's good to have a hobby,

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: so I thought I'd try picking one up myself.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Do you have any hobbies, Cutey?
Yeah.
I like watching movies and working out.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Then recommend a hobby for me.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: What kind of hobby do you think would suit me?
You're good with tech stuff, so maybe try solving some math problems?

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: They're pretty similar since they both make you think,

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: but aren't hobbies usually supposed to be something different?

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Then again, maybe I should try a little of everything for now.
Maxwell doesn't respond for a while.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: I just tried a bunch online,

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: but they were way too easy to keep me interested.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Got anything else?
How about learning to play an instrument you'd never normally play?

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Now that's interesting.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: I should give it a shot.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Though I can't exactly do that right now.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: It's not like there's an instrument lying around the power plant.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: I'll have to head into the Ark and pick one out myself.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: You'll come with me, right, Cutey?

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Instruments aren't really my area of expertise.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Hehehehe.
Okay.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: You're the best, Cutey.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: I'm on my way, so get ready and come outside.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Hehehehehe.
Okay.
